review_notes: I read the whole file (lines 1–100). The only substantial new concept is `underlying`, a functor `SheafedSpace CommRingCat ⥤ SheafedSpace (Type v)`. I grepped Mathlib's `Geometry/RingedSpace` for an equivalent functor. Mathlib only has `Functor.mapPresheaf` on `PresheafedSpace` (PresheafedSpace.lean:398), and `underlying` uses it directly on the underlying presheafed space. The `SheafedSpace` file lists no map-along-a-functor construction. A grep of the Formal Frontier library found a parallel `AbelianForget/SheafedSpace.lean` for `AddCommGrpCat`. That is a different source category, not a competing version of the same concept. The remaining declarations are simp lemmas, strict-commutation `rfl` lemmas, and a mate lemma about the sheaf-pullback adjunction. They are not competing definitions. I found no justified duplicate. The one remaining uncertainty is whether Mathlib has a generic sheaf-preserving `SheafedSpace` map elsewhere. I did not find one.
